title: 第23章 执法者 我是慕容雅大人的狗第24章 比炼丹谁会自取其辱
slug: 被逐出宗门后师尊师姐后悔终生
content_zh:
合欢宗的红尘洞中，周通正在盘坐修炼，眉心中散发着灿烂的光芒
这里已经被改造成了药田，他将抢来的灵药种子全都种下，七星碧血莲则被他种在了药田的中心，犹如百草之王。
光是待在这个洞府里，修为都会自然增长。
“分魂境的巅峰，实在是有些不值一提。”
周通在心中默念道，他必须要迅速变强，突破再突破！
“轰隆！！”
忽然间，虚空中闪过了一声闷雷，他陡然睁开眼睛，飞身而起，将一道雷霆踢得粉碎！
“这具身体实在是太弱了。”
周通脸色凝重的说道，他的精神力堪比帝境，肉身根本无法与之匹配，是个彻彻底底的异类，无时无刻不被天道监视。
这样下去的话，不仅修为会被禁锢，甚至还会有生命危险。
当务之急，必须要淬炼肉身，将其强化到足以驾驭住精神力的地步。
然而淬炼肉身可不是简单的事情，不仅困难，而且危险重重。
稍有不慎就会让血肉残缺，留下永久的道伤。
对此周通根本不屑一顾。
最简单最高效的方法就是引动天道雷劫，用雷霆劈击肉身，达到强化的目的。
至于风险…
去他娘的风险，死了拉倒，只要能活下来就是纯赚！
想要引动雷劫，就必须要用天道刻石来布置大阵。
“嘶…天道刻石好像很珍贵啊，不知道合欢宗有没有，去问问师尊去！”
周通雷动风行，就要动身。

正当此时，小妖女冲了进来。
“小坏蛋不好了，执法者的使者找上门了，扬言要撤销合欢宗的立宗资格，师尊正与之对峙呢！”
听到这话，周通骤然一惊。
这执法者组织极为强大，负责维持秩序，铲除魔凶，有权管理和制裁所有的修炼者。
为了维持运转，执法者组织也会定期发布各种各样的任务。
完成任务就会获得功勋，凭借功勋，就能兑换到各种奇珍异宝。
而作为宗门势力，每个周期都要向执法者缴纳定额的功勋，如果长时间欠费，执法者就会取消建立宗门的资格。
合欢宗这几年名存实亡，所以执法者也从未登门，今日这事被翻了出来，就绝对不是小事。
“带我去看看！”
周通神色凝重，不难猜出，这绝对是玉清宗在搞鬼。
等赶到合欢宗外，眼前的场景却将两人都惊住了。
“我是慕容雅大人的狗！”
执法者的确上门了，但情景跟周通想象中的有所不同。只见其跪在了慕容雅的脚下，眼中满是爱慕和狂热。
女魔头的名号不是白叫的，上能九天揽月，下能五洋捉鳖，中间还能把人迷的魂飞魄散。
然而魂飞魄散也只是对方承受能力的极限，却不是慕容雅魅力的极限。
content_en:
In the Red Dust Cave of the Hehuan Sect, Zhou Tong is sitting cross-legged and practicing, with a bright light emitting from the center of his eyebrows.
This place has been transformed into a medicine field. He planted all the elixir seeds he snatched. He planted the Seven-Star Blue Blood Lotus in the center of the medicine field, like the king of herbs.
Just by staying in this cave, your cultivation level will naturally increase.
"The peak of the soul-splitting realm is really not worth mentioning."
Zhou Tong said silently in his heart that he must become stronger quickly and break through again!
"Boom!!"
Suddenly, a muffled thunder flashed in the void. He suddenly opened his eyes, flew up, and kicked the thunder to pieces!
"This body is really too weak."
Zhou Tong said with a solemn expression, his mental power is comparable to that of the Emperor, and his physical body cannot match it at all. He is a complete alien and is monitored by heaven all the time.
If this continues, not only will one's cultivation be imprisoned, one's life may even be in danger.
The most urgent task is to temper the physical body and strengthen it to the point where it can control the spiritual power.
However, tempering the body is not a simple matter. It is not only difficult, but also full of dangers.
A little carelessness will cause the flesh and blood to be mutilated, leaving permanent wounds.
Zhou Tong simply ignored this.
The simplest and most efficient method is to trigger the Heavenly Thunder Tribulation and use thunder to strike the physical body to achieve the purpose of strengthening.
As for the risks…
Damn the risk, if you die, you will be defeated, as long as you can survive, you will be a pure profit!
If you want to trigger thunder tribulation, you must use heavenly carved stones to arrange a large formation.
"Hiss...Tiandao carved stones seem to be very precious. I wonder if Hehuan Sect has them. Go ask Master!"
Zhou Tong is thunderous and popular, and he is about to set off.
At this moment, the little demon girl rushed in.
"The little rascal is in trouble. The law enforcer's messenger came to our door, threatening to revoke the Hehuan Sect's qualification to establish a sect. The master is confronting him!"
Hearing this, Zhou Tong was suddenly shocked.
This law enforcement organization is extremely powerful, responsible for maintaining order, eradicating evil spirits, and has the power to manage and sanction all practitioners.
In order to maintain operations, the Enforcer organization will also regularly issue various tasks.
Completing tasks will earn you merit, and with your merit, you can redeem various rare treasures.
As a sect force, you must pay a fixed amount of merit to the law enforcer every cycle. If you are in arrears for a long time, the law enforcer will be disqualified from establishing a sect.
The Hehuan Sect has existed in name only in recent years, so the law enforcers have never come to the door. If this matter is revealed today, it is definitely not a trivial matter.
"Take me to see it!"
Zhou Tong's expression was solemn, and it was not difficult to guess that this was definitely Yu Qingzong's mischief.
When they arrived outside the Hehuan Sect, the scene in front of them shocked both of them.
"I am Master Murongya's dog!"
The law enforcers did come to the door, but the scene was different from what Zhou Tong imagined. He was seen kneeling at Murong Ya's feet, his eyes full of love and enthusiasm.
The name of the female devil is not for nothing. She can hold the moon in the sky, catch turtles in the five oceans, and in the middle, she can drive people away.
However, losing one's soul is only the limit of the opponent's ability to bear it, but it is not the limit of Murong Ya's charm.
